**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 13:19  
[FACT] User is considering setting up a mesh network system at home.  
[PREFERENCE] User is leaning towards the 3-pack of Google Wifi for better coverage.  
[FACT] User has a medium-sized home with a few thick walls and multiple rooms.  
[FACT] User has a few devices connected to their network.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Wifi is a mesh network system developed by Google that provides whole-home Wi-Fi coverage using multiple access points (APs).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Wifi consists of multiple Wifi points that communicate with each other to create a strong, single network.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Coverage of a single Wifi point is up to 1,500 square feet (around 140 square meters).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Coverage of a 3-pack is up to 9,000 square feet (around 840 square meters).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Wifi has dual-band AC1200 (2.4GHz and 5GHz) with speeds of up to 1.2 Gbps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Each Wifi point has a range of around 1,500 square feet (around 140 square meters).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average latency for Google Wifi is around 10-20 ms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The 3-pack includes three Wifi points designed to work together as a mesh network.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The 3-pack is designed for larger homes or homes with multiple floors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The typical price for a single Wifi point is around $129-$149 USD.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The typical price for a 3-pack is around $299-$329 USD.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The setup process for the 3-pack involves unboxing, plugging in the points, downloading the Google Wifi app, creating an account, and following in-app instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The app provides a visual representation of the network, device management, network performance insights, troubleshooting tools, firmware updates, parental controls, and guest network setup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The app will guide the user through the placement optimization process for the Wifi points.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The 3-pack is a more convenient option for ensuring whole-home coverage without worrying about individual Wifi point placements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The 3-pack is designed to provide better coverage, performance, and capacity than a single Wifi point.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The 3-pack is recommended for homes with complex layouts or
